Table 1. Global growth is expected to moderate
Note: Difference from December 2025 OECD Economic Outlook in percentage points, based on rounded figures. World and G20 aggregates
use moving nominal GDP weights at purchasing power parities (PPPs). Revisions to PPP estimates affect the differences in the aggregates.
Based on data available up to 23 March 2026.
1. The European Union is a full member of the G20, but the G20 aggregate only includes countries that are also members in their own right.
2. Spain is a permanent invitee to the G20.
3. Fiscal years, starting in April.
Source: OECD Interim Economic Outlook 119 database; and OECD Economic Outlook 118 database.
